mission.title: The Flit Gun
mission.description: Trade insecticide ingredients to the Machines for the parts of a flit gun.

npc.say: Watch yourself around the Machines, operative. Supposedly they always keep their word, but... Well, I wouldn't want to be there the first time they broke it.
Operator, get me an exit! Operator? Hello?
I suggest that you depart immediately, human. We are unable to guarantee your safety in this sector.
We need to get those flit gun components in the safe immediately. Is something wrong?
I don't trust the Machines. They'd better not be pulling a fast one on us with these components.
We almost didn't get here in time to set up: those imposter Agent bastards jacked our designated hardline.
I hope those Exiles do try something--we're ready for them!

phase.briefing: Well met, soldier of Zion! We have a crucial and delicate mission for you today, a mission whose outcome will determine the success of our struggle against the Merovingian's deadly Assassin. The "flit gun" shown in the schematic you recovered from the Machines looks like the ideal delivery device for our red insecticide. Unfortunately, we do not have sufficient engineering resources to code a working flit gun from scratch. After much discussion, the Council has arranged a deal with the Machines whereby we will trade them insecticide ingredients for flit gun parts. Once we have the parts, we can decompile them to learn their component code. You will be our representative in this vital exchange. Proceed to our facility in the City and pick up the insecticide ingredients from our contact, Coyote.

enter.say: That's the place. Coyote should have the insecticide ingredients ready for you.

objective.text: Get the first insecticide ingredient from Coyote

done.say: Good to see you, {player}. You weren't followed, were you? Ha-ha, just a little joke of mine. Here, take these insecticide ingredients.

objective.text: Get the second insecticide ingredient from Coyote
Get the third insecticide ingredient from Coyote

done.say: You'll need these insecticide ingredients to make the trade with the Machines.

phase.briefing: You'll be trading the first ingredient for a flit gun handle prototype, {player}. Your contact for this exchange is Agent Wilson. Be advised that we are reading increased patrols of the Merovingian's Exiles in the City. We know that they seek to prevent us from using the insecticide on the Assassin; let us hope that they do not learn of our trade agreement with the Machines. Be cautious, {player}. ... Tyndall out.

enter.say: Well, the good news is that Agent Wilson is in there; the bad news is that Agent Wilson is in there. I don't know about you, but hanging out with Agents gives me the willies.

talk.say: Human, I have the flit gun handle prototype. I perceive that you have the insecticide ingredient. Give it to me, and we shall make the exchange.

objective.text: Give the first insecticide ingredient to Agent Wilson
Get the flit gun handle prototype from Agent Wilson

done.say: Time is a limiting factor. Take the flit gun handle. Quickly.

phase.briefing: You'll trade the second ingredient for a flit gun casing prototype. Your contact for this exchange is Dobrovoleva. The Exile presence has increased dramatically in your sector, {player}. We don't yet know if they're zeroing in on you, but it looks as though something in the area has caught their attention.

enter.say: Exiles, shmexiles! They've sure been getting nosy since they killed Morpheus. I'm scanning a signal matching Dobrovoleva's reported profile in there, along with a few others. Looks quiet.

talk.say: 'Bout damn time you got here. The Machines told me to keep this low-profile, but my controller tells me this district is swarming with Exile patrols. So let's do this fast, right? Gimme the insecticide ingredient.

objective.text: Give the second insecticide ingredient to Dobrovoleva

talk.say: Damn it, just give me the ingredient!

objective.text: Get the flit gun casing prototype from Dobrovoleva

done.say: This better be the real stuff. ... Okay, take the casing. Come on, come on.
I'm picking up incoming Exile programs! We can't let them get either the casing or the ingredient--you've got to take them out!
What's that, operator? Exiles? In the building? Aw, crap!
That's all the hostiles. You'd better get out of there with the casing prototype.

phase.briefing: I heard about the ambush, Warrior; it appears as though the Exiles are targeting your trades somehow. Under less critical circumstances I would postpone the rest of your mission until we can better ensure your safety, but Zion must have those flit gun components immediately! Please do whatever you can to obtain the final part, the gun barrel. Your Machine contact for the exchange is Wong The Exterminator.

enter.say: I don't like the looks of these readings: Wong The Exterminator's signature is very faint, and there's a lot of other activity in there.
Damn, I was afraid of that: they got to Wong The Exterminator. Hey, my scan says that Franke has the gun barrel--get it back!

objective.text: Get the gun barrel from Franke's body

done.say: Good work, but we're still without a Machine to give the insecticide ingredient to in exchange. Wait... An Agent just popped up on my scanner; he should be in there with you somewhere. Go find him.

talk.say: This area is not quite secure. We cannot allow Exiles to witness the exchange.
You heard the program: time to finish off the rest of the Exiles.

objective.text: Kill the rest of the Exiles

done.say: That's all of them. Agent Wong should be ready for the ingredient now.

objective.text: Give the third insecticide ingredient to Agent Wong

done.say: Very well, human. I will receive the ingredient now.

phase.briefing: You've got all the flit gun components--wonderful! Take them to our operative, Arago; he'll begin the process of breaking down and analyzing their code. Hopefully, we will be able to begin producing functional copies of the gun almost immediately. Hurry, soldier! Lives hang in the balance!

enter.say: That's where you're supposed to meet Arago. I swear, if any more Exiles pop out of the woodwork, I'm gonna scream.

talk.say: You've got the components? Great. Put them in the safe here. The scanners embedded in it will begin decompiling the flit gun code.

objective.text: Put the flit gun handle prototype in the safe
Put the flit gun casing prototype in the safe
Put the gun barrel in the safe

complete.say: Zion's mainframes are receiving and processing the data now. We should have something shortly.

mission.finish: That was well done, {player}. It seems that the Machines kept their end of the bargain: our hackers were able to decompile the components you gathered, and we will soon be able to begin mass-producing them for use against the Assassin's flies. We will send you one as soon as they are ready. Once you and our other loyal operatives have these weapons in hand, it will not be long before we rid the Matrix of the Assassin's foul presence.
